summary: Mistwalker and AQ Interactive's Wii action RPG directed by Hironobu Sakaguchi.

emulation.notes: Use legal disc dumps; test controller mapping and any texture/graphics enhancements before a full run.

primary.why: The Last Story only released on Wii; Dolphin upscaling is the highest-fidelity capture route while preserving the original game.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally dumped Wii disc image in Dolphin with a Classic Controller profile or Wii Remote/Nunchuk mapping. Original Wii or Wii U hardware is also valid if capture convenience matters less.
